items.why: Oil is climbing again, with investors weighing Tesla and Meta earnings as the Dow and S&P 500 fall and futures drop.
Volatility is up nearly 3.5% as the tech selloff deepens and hedge fund returns worsen this week.
AMD is up as tech steadies to end a rocky week, with the Nasdaq rising after the sharp sell-off even as the Dow and S&P 500 drop.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Late Friday tape: Dow futures down 1.16%, S&P futures down 0.45%, Nasdaq futures flat as tech steadies.
summary: It is a split Friday: the Dow and S&P 500 are falling while the Nasdaq holds up after the sharp tech sell-off, and oil is climbing into the close of a rocky week.
